title: License-text snapshot capture in provenance flow
context: The license+data-tier gate requires provenance to include a committed copy of the source license text, a SHA-256 hash of that copy, and a Wayback Machine save URL — not just a bare URL that can disappear or change. This standard is reused from the sibling open-data-datasheets project. The M1 gate hardening task wires this snapshot step into the provenance flow so every pack's license.snapshotRef is automatically populated and verifiable.
objective: Implement a license-text snapshot utility that fetches and commits a local copy of a license text/page, computes its SHA-256, and saves a Wayback Machine URL, populating the license.snapshotRef field in the manifest provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: Implements committed local copy of the license text/page + SHA-256 + Wayback save URL; license.snapshotRef records committed path + hash + Wayback timestamp.
A bare URL alone is insufficient — the utility must produce and commit the snapshot artifact.
Wired into the licensegate-002 provenance flow so it runs as part of the per-source gate step.
Code is MIT-licensed; tests + CI green; no credentials embedded; commit is DCO signed-off.
resources: Wayback Machine Save Page API: https://archive.org/help/wayback_api.php
output: packages/provenance/src/snapshot.ts — license-text snapshot utility wired into the provenance flow; submitted as a PR.
